 Community Watchlist Portfolio Search stocks, sectors, indices or pages News Energy Quick read Petrol price drops Rs1, diesel rises Rs2 per litre
 Mettis Global • 21 Nov 2026, 7:24 AM PKT • 1 min read 
 ENG اردو A- A+ Add as preferred source on Google X f Mettis Global reported that OGRA changed the ex-depot prices of petrol and high-speed diesel from November 21, 2026. Petrol is now priced at Rs322.00 per litre, down Rs1.00, while high-speed diesel costs Rs357.00 per litre, up Rs2.00. The previous prices, effective on November 20, were Rs323.00 for petrol and Rs355.00 for diesel.
 The authority made the revisions under the petroleum pricing mechanism approved by the Federal Government. The changes therefore move the two major fuels in opposite directions, with the diesel increase twice the size of the petrol reduction. These updated rates apply from November 21, 2026, and the report does not provide any further information on the next review or future prices.
 At a glance
 OGRA reduced petrol to Rs322.00 per litre from November 21, 2026.
 High-speed diesel increased to Rs357.00 per litre.
 The revised rates follow the Federal Government-approved pricing mechanism.
